title: Aureline M5 supported-line proof-artifact retention policy
description: Canonical per-domain retention-policy record minted by the retention-policy and stale-escalation lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Defines the retention, export, and review-cadence rule for one B147 supported-line proof artifact class — a public-proof-ledger policy, a migration-scoreboard policy, a transparency-report policy, a correction-archive policy, a truth-feed policy, or an ORR-history policy — so the artifacts introduced by B147 stay current, diffable, and line-canonical after they first ship instead of decaying into one-off launch appendices. Each policy names the artifact class it governs, its accountable owner and backup owner, its review cadence (monthly or per-release-train), its retention window, its archive class, and its destruction-or-long-term-retention disposition, and marks whether the class is public-safe or internal-only, so every B147 artifact class has an owner, cadence, retention window, and stale-escalation rule that can be inspected in one checked-in policy packet. Policies are bound to exact build / release-line identity and link out to the canonical proof registries rather than restating their content. Raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
